docs(README): replace fanout 'sweet spot' claim with actual measured data

The earlier 'N=64 modal consensus 80%, N=200 78%' claim came from a
single-task fanout run with use_cache=True; the kernel's ReceiptCache
deduplicated identical prompts and collapsed the modal distribution,
making 64 and 200 look identical. The cache-off matrix run on
Qwen2.5-Coder-3B shows the real picture: easy tasks saturate at N=64
(100% per-attempt, fan-out adds nothing) but some hard tasks where
every attempt fails

ci: drop bun version floor, track latest only (#42)

The matrix's 1.1.0 floor cannot read the JSON `bun.lock` (`lockfileVersion: 1`,
only supported since bun 1.2.0), so every release-tag push failed at
`bun install --frozen-lockfile`. The `engines.bun` constraint and the
parallel floor-testing rail are not earning their keep for this repo - dev
and runtime track the current bun line - so the matrix and the engines
block are removed in favor of a single `bun-version: latest` job.

fallback loop then re-checked the key and pushed it to

fontsize through the font.size path.

修改檔案：
- ShrimpCharacter.tsx：PartGroup transform 陣列完全反轉
  - v5/v6 順序：[T(-pivot), T(-pivot), S, S, R, T(pivot), T(pivot), T(pos)]

fix(sessions): avoid stale restart continuation reuse

Avoid stale restart continuation reuse after a session key has rotated.

Queued restart agent turns now carry the session id they were queued for and fall back to a system wake if the key points at a different session by delivery time. Normal completed-run lifecycle fields stay reusable for fresh sessions, while new-session creation clears stale lifecycle markers.

Closes #86593.

fix(gateway): drain probe client close

Gateway probe now waits for GatewayClient.stopAndWait() before resolving so callers do not observe a successful probe while the client socket is still draining. If the drain fails, probe falls back to stop().

Adds mocked probe coverage plus a real WebSocket regression test that verifies no client socket handle remains when probeGateway() resolves.
